rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Compliance Shield generates EU AI Act compliance audit trails and evidence for AI agent systems. It performs risk classification, documents compliance artifacts, and produces reports that support regulatory review. The server helps teams demonstrate conformity with transparency, accountability, and oversight requirements under the EU AI Act.
